description: Step 4 of the fz-sc8.197 page. A body sends eleven operators to Kernel (direct_operator_name, jobs/body.rs); a guard sends five (arithmetic_function) and implements the six comparisons itself in jobs/native.rs, native_codegen/receive.rs and ir_interp/dispatch_exec.rs. Measured in a spike: guard == and != through Kernel builds, output identical, run unchanged, compile +0.8%. Remove arithmetic_function and PatternGuardBinOp::{Eq, Neq} from the three evaluators.
title: A guard and a body resolve operators through one table; guard == and != go through Kernel
